results.title: Perspective Chapter: Integrating Space Technology Innovations into ...
results.content: A key takeaway is the need for educational frameworks to adapt to the rapid advancements in space technology and the changing demands of the twenty-first-century workforce by incorporating learning and innovation skills such as creativity, critical thinking, communication, and collaboration which are highlighted as essential for success in today’s rapidly changing world. By synergizing STEM disciplines with human-centric skills, educational institutions can foster a holistic learning environment that prepares students to become innovative problem-solvers and effective collaborators in the rapidly evolving landscape of space technology [2]. By bridging STEM and human-centric skills, educators can empower students to become innovative problem-solvers, effective communicators, and collaborative team members, prepared to tackle the complex challenges and opportunities of the space sector. The integration of space technologies into education holds immense benefits for schools, governments, and families alike, by inspiring the next generation of scientists, engineers, and innovators, equipping students with the skills and knowledge necessary to succeed in the twenty-first-century workforce, addressing critical global challenges such as climate change, resource management, and space exploration [98].
